first90Days.focus: Sponsor alignment, scope one domain, name stewards
activities: Verify sponsor budget authority; qualify out if absent
Draft, socialise and sign the DG charter
Place the council within the existing committee hierarchy
Agree the first domain and write the exclusions explicitly
Name Data Owners and secure written acceptance
Name stewards with a countersigned time percentage
Capture the benefit baseline before delivery starts
first90Days.exitArtefact: Signed charter, named and time-allocated roles, benefit baseline recorded

first90Days.focus: CDE identification via backward lineage from top reports
activities: Select the consumption points that define criticality
Identify the priority regulatory returns and their line items
Trace lineage backwards from each consumption point to source fields
Consolidate and de-duplicate into a draft CDE register
Rate criticality and assign owner and steward per element
Ratify the register at council and place it under change control
first90Days.exitArtefact: CDE register — typically 50–100 elements for a first domain — ratified and owned

first90Days.focus: Deploy catalogue, ingest metadata, build glossary
activities: Confirm the tooling decision and deploy the platform
Configure connectors; prove extraction from the vendor core
Schedule automated harvest with failure alerting
Populate the glossary for governed terms and resolve contested definitions
Bind every CDE to its physical columns
Capture lineage for the governed elements and classify each one
first90Days.exitArtefact: Live catalogue with glossary, binding, classification and lineage for the scoped domain

first90Days.focus: Author and run DQ rules on CDEs
activities: Profile the source systems and establish a defect baseline
Tailor rules from the library and agree thresholds with owners
Deploy rules to the engine and schedule execution
Stand up the scorecard layer over the result store
Publish the first scorecard and walk owners through their results
Enforce at least one policy as code in a pipeline
first90Days.exitArtefact: First DQ scorecard published — the artefact that funds the following six months

first90Days.focus: Issue workflow live, first council cycle, remediate top defects
activities: Open the issue queue and triage the first tranche of defects
Run the first full council cycle with recorded decisions
Remediate the five highest-severity defects and evidence the change
Measure defect-rate movement against the baseline
Assemble the derivation and lineage evidence pack
Scope the next domain using the same derivation method
first90Days.exitArtefact: Governance running with a measurable delta, and the next wave scoped

waves.name: Mobilise & Derive
waves.theme: Authority and scope. No technical build until the mandate and the element list exist.
objectives: Establish an authority base that survives the first cross-domain dispute
Convert the charter into named people with allocated time
Produce a finite, defensible CDE register derived from consumption
deliverables: Signed DG charter and constituted council
Ownership register with written acceptances
Steward allocation letters countersigned by line managers
Ratified CDE register with owners and criticality
Benefit baseline record
kpis: Percentage of CDEs with a named steward
waves.exitCriteria: Charter signed, stewards time-allocated, CDE register ratified at council. Gates G1–G6.
externalDependencies: Access to regulatory reporting and risk specialists

waves.name: Platform & Catalogue
waves.theme: Make the estate addressable. Catalogue, glossary, lineage and classification for the scoped domain.
objectives: Deploy the platform and prove extraction from the vendor core
Populate the glossary and bind every CDE to physical columns
Capture lineage end to end and classify every governed element
deliverables: Catalogue, quality engine and lineage collector running
Scheduled metadata harvest with failure alerting
Glossary populated with contested definitions resolved at council
CDE-to-column binding complete
Classification recorded against every governed CDE
waves.exitCriteria: Harvest running on schedule; every CDE has a definition, a binding, a lineage path and a classification.

waves.name: Quality & Scorecard
waves.theme: Make governance visible. Rules bound to CDEs, executing on schedule, published as a number the business recognises.
objectives: Establish a defect baseline through profiling
Deploy the rule set against every governed CDE
Publish a scorecard and get it reviewed at council
deliverables: Profiling baseline per source system
Deployed rule set with owner-agreed thresholds
Published DQ scorecard with a named owner per failing rule
Issue queue open and triaged by stewards
At least one policy enforced as code in a pipeline
waves.exitCriteria: Scorecard published and reviewed at council; issues being triaged by stewards rather than by the delivery team. Gate G8.

waves.name: Regulatory Defensibility
waves.theme: Convert lineage and quality into evidence a regulator or auditor will accept without a three-week investigation.
objectives: Complete return line-item to source-field lineage for the priority submissions
Automate reconciliation between GL, subledger and source
Assemble a maintained evidence pack
deliverables: Return line-item lineage for the priority submissions
Automated reconciliation controls with break ageing
Manual intervention and end-user-computing register with risk ratings
Regulator-presentable derivation evidence pack
Model and ECL input quality controls running pre-execution
kpis: Return line items with complete lineage
waves.exitCriteria: Derivation of any priority return line item can be evidenced on request from live lineage.

waves.name: Master Data & Single Customer View
waves.theme: Fix the entity resolution problem that silently breaks exposure aggregation, KYC currency and customer analytics.
objectives: Define and publish the golden customer record
Establish the stewardship queue for match exceptions
Make group and related-party aggregation reliable
deliverables: Golden record definition with survivorship rules
Match and merge rules keyed on validated national identifiers
Stewardship queue live for match exceptions
Group and related-party linkage register
Reference code-set register with named owners and change control
waves.exitCriteria: Group exposure can be aggregated on demand with evidenced completeness; duplicate rate trending down.

waves.name: AI & Consumption Readiness
waves.theme: Turn the governed estate into an AI-deployable one — the wedge that opened the engagement, now closed out.
objectives: Publish a certified dataset and report register
Install a data-readiness gate in the AI and analytics intake
Make model inputs traceable to governed elements
deliverables: Certified report and trusted dataset register
AI intake process with an enforced data-readiness gate
Model input traceability to governed CDEs
Classification and entitlement controls extended to the AI consumption layer
Shadow reporting inventory with a rationalisation plan
kpis: Use cases passing the readiness gate
waves.exitCriteria: An AI use case has passed the gate on evidence rather than assertion, with entitlements enforced at query time.

waves.name: Run, Prove & Expand
waves.theme: Prove the client can run a full cycle unaided, evidence the benefit, and onboard the next domain.
objectives: Demonstrate handover independence over a full cycle
Measure benefit against the pre-programme baseline
Scope and mobilise the next domain
deliverables: Full monthly cycle run by client staff with the delivery team observing
Benefit realisation report against baseline
Access recertification executed with exceptions closed
Next domain scope statement using the same derivation method
Transition into the managed governance retainer
waves.exitCriteria: Client-run cycle completed; benefit evidenced; next domain scoped. Gate G10.

artefactRegister.artefact: Council terms of reference and decision rights
Golden record definition and match rules
AI readiness gate in the intake process
Monthly scorecard with trend and commentary
Council pack, decisions log and action tracker
Examination and audit evidence pack, maintained current
Framework alignment statement (DMBOK2, DCAM, DGI, COBIT 2019)
